name: koda-workspace
description: Workspace root of KODA. The SDK lives in packages/core and the CLI in packages/koda.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @koda-tools/core && npm run build -w @koda-tools/acp && npm run build -w @koda-tools/koda
scripts.koda: npm run build -w @koda-tools/core && npm run build -w @koda-tools/acp && npm run koda -w @koda-tools/koda
scripts.check: npm run build -w @koda-tools/core && npm run check -w @koda-tools/core && npm run check -w @koda-tools/acp && npm run check -w @koda-tools/koda
scripts.format: npm run format -w @koda-tools/core && npm run format -w @koda-tools/acp && npm run format -w @koda-tools/koda
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check -w @koda-tools/core && npm run format:check -w @koda-tools/acp && npm run format:check -w @koda-tools/koda
